oauth2.description: OAuth2 tokens auto-refresh via refresh token. Rotate refresh tokens every 90 days.
oauth2.procedure: Re-authenticate through n8n credentials UI to obtain new refresh token.

api_key.description: API keys must be manually regenerated from the provider dashboard.
api_key.procedure: Generate new key in provider dashboard, update in n8n credentials UI, verify connectivity, revoke old key.

app_token.description: Application tokens must be manually regenerated from the provider.
app_token.procedure: Generate new token in provider settings, update in n8n credentials UI, verify connectivity.

webhook.description: Webhook secrets have longer rotation periods as they require coordinated updates.
webhook.procedure: Generate new webhook secret, update both sender and receiver configurations simultaneously.
